code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low O₂ saturation, low pO₂, very low pH), mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and elevated ferritin, LDH, ALP, and inflammatory markers. There is also mild hypoglycemia and hypoalbuminemia. Findings suggest acute severe respiratory compromise with systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and multi-organ involvement. Immediate clinical evaluation is warranted.
